referenceHeightMethod.method: Each identity/bearing sheet uses its own fresh integer median of ready, load and ram visible-cap-to-near-support-sole spans. With three integer spans there is no half-up tie. The fire span corroborates the same physical kit; all four phases share that one reference and no phase is normalized separately.
referenceHeightMethod.capInterpretation: Cap-only half-open ROIs use visible crown/rim pixels. Where a raised sleeve occludes the crown, the exposed left cap rim is measured; hidden anatomy is not reconstructed. B-NW load also excludes adjacent gun fringe.
referenceHeightMethod.groundInterpretation: Root X independently estimates the pelvis projection. Root Y is the exclusive alpha>=64 maximum inside the independently chosen nearer supporting boot ROI. Root X need not lie inside that sole ROI.
referenceHeightMethod.nativeCoordinateUncertainty: Projected pelvis X is approximately +/-8 pixels on N sheets and +/-5 on smaller NW sheets. Occluded cap rims and muzzle lips have a few pixels of semantic uncertainty even though the recorded alpha extrema are exactly reproducible.

crossBearingReview.kit: The N/NW and existing v27 NE references preserve navy coat/cap, light-blue trousers, brown boots/straps, tan roll, black pack and left-side canteen. A keeps a black pouch; B keeps a brown pouch. Relative head, roll and limb proportions are coherent within and across the four new stationary sheets.
crossBearingReview.sampling: The NW sources have roughly 255-259 native pixels of reference body height versus 375-378 in N. They are visibly softer in small hands, fittings and muzzle detail at a comparable enlarged display size. Their simpler small silhouette remains usable for a bounded opt-in game sprite; this is not equal native-detail quality or a close-zoom quality certificate.
crossBearingReview.identity: B-N is a builtin whole-image edit of the A-N composition with the B kit reference. Its brown pouch remains consistent across all four poses. All four whole-source hashes and all four phase RGBA hashes per sheet are distinct; no independent-face or wholly unrelated-composition claim is made.
crossBearingReview.generationBoundary: Selected A-NW, B-N and B-NW were generated whole-image edits. The staged sources match complete imagegen output bytes. No host-side source raster transforms, individual phase resizes or mirroring were applied by this reviewer.

cellObservations.observation: Ready: coherent straight north rear view, black A pouch and pack, tan blanket roll and left-side canteen. Upright carried musket is distinct from firing.

Fire: north-directed foreshortened barrel, shoulder/head/elbow change and braced support distinguish firing from ready. Rear hands and aperture are partly hidden; the mouth is a visible steel-rim estimate before the bayonet.
Load: raised hand at muzzle and lower gun support distinguish loading. The raised sleeve overlaps the cap crown; the cap-only ROI uses its visible left rim and excludes the sleeve and gun.
Ram: higher hand and thin rod distinguish the second reload stage. North bearing, body scale and black A kit remain coherent.

limitations: The rear firing grips and some muzzle openings are partly occluded; the recorded mouths are visible steel-rim estimates before the bayonet, not anatomical or drill certification.
Colored and very-low-alpha fringe remains. Solid alpha>=64 clearance is at least16 native pixels in every cell but does not establish fringe-free output.
Smaller NW sources lose fine detail at enlarged display sizes; actual game zoom, loading, firing/reload timing, terrain contrast and formation overlap must be checked during integration.
Within-sheet source scale acceptance does not certify whole-family continuity, all motion, historical equipment accuracy or human usability.
The N/NE/NW marching fallback remains unchanged and incomplete. This source group adds only ready, fire and two reload phases at N/NW for A and B.
No browser, GPU, gameplay, release, default-art or local-install acceptance is issued by this source-only review.
